attributes.canonicalTitle: An Angry Showdown! Cross the Red Line!
attributes.synopsis: Episode 61 is "half-filler" episode. The first half (00:00 - 13:00) is filler content which concludes the filler arc "Warship Island". The second half (13:00 - 24:00) is canon and the beginning of "Reverse Mountain" arc.

attributes.canonicalTitle: The First Line of Defense? The Giant Whale Laboon Appears!
attributes.synopsis: The Straw Hat crew takes a wild ride up and down a mountain only to end up in the belly of a giant whale that’s on the lookout for pirates!

attributes.canonicalTitle: A Promise Between Men! Luffy and the Whale Vow to Meet Again!
attributes.synopsis: Luffy trades blows with Laboon the whale, and Nami is distressed to learn that navigating the Grand Line is no easy feat.

attributes.canonicalTitle: A Town that Welcomes Pirates? Setting Foot on Whisky Peak!
attributes.synopsis: A violent snow storm batters the crew of the Going Merry, but once the Straw Hats arrive at Whisky Peak, the locals invite them to a raucous celebration.

attributes.canonicalTitle: Explosion! The Three Swords Style! Zoro vs. Baroque Works!
attributes.synopsis: There are bounty hunters on the prowl, and most of the Straw Hats are dead drunk. Only Zoro is still sober enough to hoist a sword.

attributes.canonicalTitle: All Out Battle! Luffy vs. Zoro, Mysterious Grand Duel!
attributes.synopsis: There’s a mysterious princess that needs protection from a nose-picking assassin, but Luffy and Zoro are too busy duking it out to worry about explosive boogers.

attributes.canonicalTitle: Deliver Princess Vivi! The Luffy Pirates Set Sail!
attributes.synopsis: The Straw Hats depart Whisky Peak on a mission to return the Princess of Alabasta to her kingdom while protecting her from an army of vicious assassins.

attributes.canonicalTitle: Try Hard, Coby! Coby and Helmeppo's Struggles in the Marines!
attributes.synopsis: While the crew heads for Little Garden with the princess, Luffy and Zoro’s old nemesis, Axe-Hand Morgan, escapes from a Marine prison ship.

attributes.canonicalTitle: Coby and Helmeppo's Resolve! Vice-Admiral Garp's Parental Affection!
attributes.synopsis: Colby and Helmeppo train day and night to prove they’re tough enough to be Marines. A violent showdown with Vice-Admiral Garp will determine if they’re worth their salt.

attributes.canonicalTitle: An Ancient Island! The Shadow Hiding in Little Garden!
attributes.synopsis: Luffy’s gang is running low on supplies, so they stop at Little Garden to find something to eat. Unfortunately for them, it might end up the other way around.

attributes.canonicalTitle: Huge Duel! The Giants Dorry and Brogy!
attributes.synopsis: Not only are there dinosaurs running wild on the island of Little Garden, but the Straw Hats soon find themselves in the middle of a gargantuan grudge match.

attributes.canonicalTitle: Luffy Gets Angry! A Dirty Trick Violates the Sacred Duel!
attributes.synopsis: Usopp and Luffy are fascinated by the endless battle waged between Dorry and Broggy; however, fascination turns to outrage when Monkey catches a whiff of treachery.

attributes.canonicalTitle: Broggy's Bitter Tears of Victory! The Conclusion of Elbaf!
attributes.synopsis: Luffy’s blood boils for revenge against the assassins who sabotaged Dorry and Broggy’s battle, but he’s currently trapped between a rock and a hard place.

attributes.canonicalTitle: The Devilish Candle! Tears of Regret and Tears of Anger!
attributes.synopsis: While Luffy struggles to free himself, his friends fall into the hands of Baroque Works. Though the odds are against them, the Straw Hats will never give up!

attributes.canonicalTitle: A Hex on Luffy! Colors Trap!
attributes.synopsis: Nami, Zoro, and the Princess are in danger of becoming exhibits in a fiendish artist’s collection, and only Luffy can save them. But he’s busy having a cup of tea.

attributes.canonicalTitle: Time to Fight Back! Usopp's Quick Thinking and Fire Star!
attributes.synopsis: With his friends about to be permanently entombed in wax, Usopp is provided with the perfect opportunity to be brave and make his father proud.

attributes.canonicalTitle: Farewell Giant Island! Head for Alabasta!
attributes.synopsis: After narrowly avoiding death, Luffy’s crew and the Princess set sail for Alabasta, but something large and dangerous looms in their path.

attributes.canonicalTitle: Nami's Sick? Beyond the Snow Falling on the Sea!
attributes.synopsis: Nami comes down with a terrible fever and the Straw Hats don’t know what to do. Looks like the Grand Line might claim another victim.

attributes.canonicalTitle: A Raid! The Bliking and Blik Wapol!
attributes.synopsis: The Straw Hats continue their quest to find a doctor for Nami. Along the way, they deal with a ravenous invader and get a chilly reception from local islanders.

attributes.canonicalTitle: An Island without Doctors? Adventure in a Nameless Land!
attributes.synopsis: Luffy and Sanji make a bold trek up a snow-covered mountain in search of a witch who might hold the key to curing Nami.
